ex.s: Inspired by magical maps in her stories, she wondered: what if we could build a real-world app that helps people explore hidden places in their own cities?
ex.t: 受故事中神奇地图的启发，她想：如果我们能做一个现实世界的应用，帮助人们在自己城市里探索隐藏的地点，会怎样？

ex.s: She gathered friends, learned some basic programming, and together they created an app that maps small local parks and gardens few people knew about.
ex.t: 她召集了朋友，学习了一些基础编程知识，然后一起创建了一款应用程序，绘制出很少有人知道的当地小公园和花园的地图。

ex.s: Their app quickly grew popular in town and even won a local youth innovation award.
ex.t: 他们的应用很快在镇上流行起来，甚至还拿了一个本地青年创新奖。

ex.s: How does the app created by Sally and her friends help?
ex.t: 萨莉和朋友们开发的应用有什么帮助？

ex.s: “With the rise of technology it is easy for people to make observations of different species with the aid of a mobile application,” said Barnabas Daru, who is lead author of the study and assistant professor of biology in the Stanford School of Humanities and Sciences.
ex.t: 随着技术兴起，人们借助手机应用很容易观察不同物种，”该研究第一作者、斯坦福人文与科学学院生物学助理教授Barnabas Daru说。

ex.s: “Biodiversity apps can use our study results to inform users of oversampled areas and lead them to places — and even species — that are not well-sampled.
ex.t: “生物多样性应用可以利用我们的研究结果告知用户哪些地区采样过度，并引导他们去那些采样不足的地方——甚至去关注采样不足的物种。

ex.s: To improve the quality of observational data, biodiversity apps can also encourage users to have an expert confirm the identification of their uploaded image.”
ex.t: 为提高观测数据的质量，生物多样性应用也可以鼓励用户请专家确认他们上传图片的鉴定结果。”

ex.s: What is Daru’s suggestion for biodiversity apps?
ex.t: 达鲁对生物多样性应用有什么建议？

ex.s: Also, there is a convenient app that provides growing data in real time.
ex.t: 此外，还有一款便捷的应用可实时提供日益增长的数据。

ex.s: What information does the convenient app offer?
ex.t: 这款便捷的应用提供什么信息？

ex.t: 为了展示约翰想法的应用。

ex.t: 是什么让无人机应用于铁路线路成为可能？

ex.s: Its practical application.
ex.t: 具有新视角的科学家。

ex.s: Your application will be accessed by UNESCO managers and will stay in our database for six months．We do not respond to every candidate．If selected，you will be contacted by a manager．If you do not receive any update within six months，it means that your application has not been successful．
ex.t: 你的申请将由联合国教科文组织的经理审阅，并在我们的数据库中保留六个月。我们不会回复每一位候选人。如果被选中，会有经理与你联系。如果六个月内未收到任何更新，则意味着你的申请未获成功。

ex.t: 申请人在填写申请表之前应该做什么？

ex.s: Lancom is a worldwide language learning app and a leader in the online language learning industry with millions of active subscribers.
ex.t: Lancom是一款全球语言学习应用，也是在线语言学习行业的领导者，拥有数百万活跃订阅用户。

ex.s: Lancom trains your brain to learn efficiently, so you absorb more information while in the app and continue leaning outside of it.
ex.t: Lancom训练你的大脑高效学习，因此你在应用内吸收更多信息，并在应用外继续学习。

ex.s: The app makes our practical language lessons available wherever and whenever.
ex.t: 这款应用程序让我们的实用语言课程随时随地可用。

ex.s: What lies at the core of the Lancom app? （    ）
ex.t: Lancom应用的核心在于什么？（ ）

ex.s: All participants must address how communication or transportation technology has promoted the quality of life for Americans throughout history． To many people，technology means computers， hand﹣held devices， or vehicles that travel to distant planets． However， technology is also the application of scientific knowledge to solve a problem， touching lives in countless ways．
ex.t: 所有参与者必须阐述通信或交通技术如何在整个历史中提升了美国人的生活品质。对许多人来说，技术意味着电脑、手持设备，或前往遥远行星的飞行器。然而，技术也是运用科学知识解决问题，以无数种方式触动着人们的生活。

ex.s: That might mean either developing a uniform way to mark videos and images, showing when and who they were made by. or abandoning phone calls altogether and moving towards data-based communications—using apps like Face Time or WhatsApp, which can be tied to your identity.
ex.t: 这可能意味着要么开发一种统一的方式来标记视频和图像，显示它们何时以及由谁制作，要么完全放弃电话，转向使用基于数据的通信应用程序，如Face Time或WhatsApp ，这些应用程序可以与您的身份相关联。

ex.s: Thus, it's of vital importance for job seekers to carefully strategize their approach to job application.
ex.t: 他们应该尽可能让自己对雇主具有吸引力。

ex.s: After-school activities also play a part when students apply to college.
ex.t: 课后活动在学生申请上大学时也起到一定的作用。

ex.s: The app works by quickly showing photos of different food.
ex.t: 该应用程序可以快速显示不同食物的照片。

ex.s: Then I discovered an app called Running Power.
ex.t: 然后我发现了一个名为Running Power的应用程序。

ex.s: Now I no longer use the app, but I've fallen in love with running, and still do it with my running friends.
ex.t: 现在我不再使用该应用程序，但我已经爱上了跑步，并且仍然和我的跑步朋友一起做。
